acknowledged_risks.mitigation: BOOT-SEL encoding is not in the F133 datasheet: BLOCKED until the BROM boot-select table is obtained. T35 MISO is tri-stated whenever SS_N is high, and F133 PC3 has a 15 kOhm reset pull-up, so SS_N is high during F133 reset. Any required strap resistor must overpower the T35 weak pull-up (27 kOhm min) and the F133 internal pull-up (12 kOhm min).
eMMC (SMHC2) is impossible because it uses PC2-PC7 = SPI0. SPI-NOR/NAND boot would share SPI0 with T35 through a GPIO chip-select; that is not selected.

F133 DS lists Quad-Output/Quad-Input, not Quad-IO. BT820 Quad mode needs a quad address phase. Baseline uses BT820 SINGLE mode (the default, host commands work only there); Dual/Quad only after register-level confirmation in the F133 user manual and bench test.
2.2 kOhm pull-downs add ~1.5 mA per line while driven high; check T35 drive strength and SI at the selected SCLK
MN820 DS Table 2 calls VCC3V3 an 'output' while section 5.1 says the module takes a 3.0-3.6 V input; confirm with Bridgetek/VM820C schematic before layout
